setup.images: the scene's first training image, resized bilinearly with antialiasing, as the target; the prediction adds Gaussian noise of σ 0.05 (Q-190)
setup.network: openftgs.losses.PerceptualLoss(net), D-89's construction, frozen and in evaluation mode, built on the CPU and moved to CUDA for its cases; its forward on [1, H, W, 3] images (Q-41)
setup.bf16: bfloat16 autocast around the network's call, the images float32 and the value cast to float32, as the trainer runs a trunk network (Q-172, Q-250); TF32 on
setup.channels_last_weights: channels_last_inputs_and_weights: the render's view, with a copy of the network converted with to(memory_format=torch.channels_last), made once per network; the two Caffe trunks only (Q-269)
setup.processes: the networks' construction, the deviations and fused-ssim in the benchmark's process; every network's cases, one network at a time, and the PyTorch SSIM path in one child process per autotuning setting, in which fused_ssim can't be imported
setup.clock: CUDA events: loss.perceptual or loss.ssim (forward), backward (the prediction's)
